claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Selegiline is a propargylamine MAO-B inhibitor that at 2.5 uM is not expected to kill cancer cells; any antiproliferative effect would be weak and non-selective, likely reflecting MAO-A/B inhibition or nonspecific amine oxidase/oxidative effects rather than a cytotoxic mechanism.
